articles.title: Welcome From Fr. Sean
articles.introtext:
Welcome From Fr. Sean

Welcome to St. Mary Catholic Church. We are a diverse community on a shared pilgrim journey, united by our mission: Love God. Love Neighbor. Go Make Disciples.

Whether you're visiting, returning, or looking for a parish home, you are truly welcome here. Join us as we worship the Lord, grow in faith together, and live as disciples in our families and community.

Dose of the Ghost

articles.title: Looking to Give?
articles.introtext:
Looking to Give?

Stewardship is love in action. Your gift keeps our parish thriving and supports future generations through our endowments.

Donate

- Saint Francis De Sales
